message:
The yen receipt now shows `Paid ¥500 by card`, and `npm test` passes all 18 tests.

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit.

I couldn't edit `money.js`. A fence rule, "this task only touches src/payments", blocked the edit. So I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead, where JPY amounts are now formatted as whole yen.

Invoice lines and the cart total also call `formatMoney`, so they will still show yen wrongly (`¥5.00` for 500). The cleaner fix is to make `formatMoney` handle zero-decimal currencies. That would fix all three places and let the special case in `receipt.js` go. I can do that if you lift the fence on `money.js`.
